integrity: Exact global bundle and loop arguments; no experimental finite sample is substituted for a universal proof. Literature comparison is not exhaustive.
scientific_limitations: The six independent first mod-two cohomology classes and their orientation-class sum do not determine the entire first cohomology, its integral refinement, the full cohomology ring, or quotients by reflection-containing similarity groups.
title: Six independent direction classes and the orientation obstruction of quadrangle moduli
